title: Current astronauts with their own experiences
summary: Ryan Graves tells of Current astronauts with their own experiences, about recent at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I've spoke to current astronauts that have had their own instances.

plain: A former Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves, who talks about unexplained objects he and other pilots saw, says on podcast host Jesse Michels' show that he has spoken with astronauts still serving today. He says some of them have had their own experiences with such things. If true, it would mean people at the top of spaceflight have seen something too, and simply have not said so publicly.
